en-US.longDescription: Chanalyzer unlocks the full potential of your Wi-Spy or WiPry Clarity spectrum analyzer. Dial in spectrum analysis settings to see every detail. Detect and locate sources of Wi-Fi and non-Wi-Fi interference. Optimize your Wi-Fi and monitor your 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz networks in real time. Identify congestion and channel saturation. Record spectrum data for later analysis. Tag interference events with notes and images. Report on your findings with easy-to-use templates and content blocks.
en-US.name: Chanalyzer

zh-CN.longDescription: Chanalyzer 可充分发挥 Wi-Spy 或 WiPry Clarity 频谱分析仪的潜力。通过精细调整频谱分析设置，查看每一个细节，检测并定位 Wi-Fi 与非 Wi-Fi 干扰源。实时优化您的 Wi-Fi 并监控 2.4、5 和 6 GHz 频段网络，识别拥塞和信道饱和，记录频谱数据供后续分析，并使用易用的模板和内容块生成报告。
